title: StateDD feature slice contract
description: A small schema-driven contract for a single StateDD backlog slice.

slice_id.description: Stable backlog identifier for this slice, e.g. BL-005.

title.description: Short human-readable title for the slice.

goal.description: One-paragraph goal statement describing the slice's intent.

repo_role.description: Repo role this slice applies to.

statedd_mode.description: StateDD mode this slice runs in.

runtime_required.description: Whether runtime identity proof is required for acceptance.

non_goals.description: Explicit non-goals to prevent scope creep.

evidence_required.description: Whether evidence artifacts are required for acceptance.

verification_commands.description: Commands that must pass before the slice is closure-grade.

known_limits.description: Known limits or caveats for this slice.
